description: Concept only. Retain original pelvis, legs, base battery; remove complete neck/head subtree. All replacement parts fixed rigidly to pelvis.
assumptions: Shell 50 g, mount 20 g, relocated compute/cabling allowance 35 g are placeholders, not measurements.
Tab5 faces forward (+X), landscape orientation. Device dimensions and current doc masses are official; battery footprint, component COM and all uniform inertia approximations are assumed.
Tab5-battery variant adds a second battery; bare variant assumes suitable power regulation from retained base supply, which has NOT been electrically designed.
Original pelvis inertial and battery remain exactly as exported, even though hardware revision may differ.
All offsets are in original trunk_base frame. No physical neck actuator remains. Body design is a simulation concept, not manufacturing CAD.
